subject: design-technology
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: Which process builds an object up layer by layer from a digital model?
questions.explain: 3D printing is an additive process that deposits material layer by layer to build a three-dimensional object directly from a CAD file.

questions.q: A design specification is best described as:
options: A list of measurable criteria the final product must meet
The advertising slogan for the product
A list of the designer's hobbies
questions.explain: A specification is a detailed list of criteria and requirements that the finished product must satisfy, used to guide and judge the design.

questions.q: One-off (job) production is best suited to making:
options: A single bespoke item such as a tailored wedding dress
questions.explain: One-off production makes a single, often custom item to a unique specification, such as a made-to-measure product.

questions.q: A force that squashes or pushes a material together is called:
questions.explain: Compression is a squashing force that pushes material together; tension by contrast pulls it apart.

questions.q: Laminating is a manufacturing technique that involves:
options: Bonding thin layers of material together, often to create a curved or strong shape
questions.explain: Laminating bonds thin layers (such as wood veneers) together, often around a former, to build up strength or create curved shapes.

questions.q: Which is an example of a deforming process?
options: Vacuum forming a heated plastic sheet over a mould
questions.explain: Deforming changes a material's shape without removing or adding material, as when a heated plastic sheet is vacuum formed over a mould.

questions.q: When connecting an LED in a circuit, a resistor is usually placed in series to:
options: Limit the current so the LED is not damaged
Make the LED brighter than its maximum
questions.explain: A series current-limiting resistor protects the LED by keeping the current within its safe operating limit.

questions.q: Glass-reinforced plastic (GRP), used for boat hulls, is a composite of:
options: Glass fibres set in a polymer resin
questions.explain: GRP combines glass fibres with a polymer resin matrix to create a strong, lightweight, water-resistant composite.

questions.q: A linkage in a mechanism is used to:
options: Change the direction or type of motion between parts
questions.explain: Linkages are bars connected by pivots that transfer or change the direction and nature of motion in a mechanism.

questions.q: What does CAM stand for in design and technology?
questions.explain: CAM stands for Computer-Aided Manufacture, where computer-controlled machines such as CNC routers make a product from a CAD file.

questions.q: Which of these is a thermochromic (smart) material?
options: A pigment that changes colour with temperature
A board made from recycled paper
An alloy that returns to a remembered shape when heated
questions.explain: Thermochromic materials change colour in response to temperature changes, used in items like mood rings and battery testers.

questions.q: The main purpose of a capacitor in a basic circuit is to:
questions.explain: A capacitor stores electrical charge and can be used for timing, smoothing and energy-storage functions in circuits.

questions.q: Primary research in the design process means gathering:
options: Data that is always out of date
New, first-hand data such as your own surveys or interviews
Information from existing books, websites and reports
questions.explain: Primary research is original, first-hand data collected directly, such as questionnaires, interviews or measurements.

questions.q: A resistor in a circuit is used to:
options: Limit or control the flow of current
questions.explain: A resistor opposes the flow of current, controlling how much current passes through a part of the circuit.

questions.q: Which of these is an output device?
questions.explain: A buzzer is an output device that converts an electrical signal into sound; switches, LDRs and thermistors are inputs.

questions.q: A template is most useful when you need to:
options: Mark out the same shape repeatedly and accurately
questions.explain: A template is a pattern used to mark out or cut identical shapes quickly and consistently.

questions.q: Cartridge paper is most commonly used by designers for:
questions.explain: Cartridge paper has a slightly textured surface that suits sketching and presenting design ideas in pencil, pen and paint.

questions.q: A potential divider made from two resistors is used to:
options: Provide a fixed lower output voltage from a higher supply
Increase the supply voltage above the battery
questions.explain: A potential divider uses two resistors to split a supply voltage, providing a smaller, fixed output voltage.

questions.q: Powder coating is a surface finish applied mainly to:
options: Metals, giving a tough durable coloured layer
questions.explain: Powder coating sprays charged powder onto metal which is then baked, forming a hard, durable, attractive finish.

questions.q: In manufacturing, a 'wastage' process is one that:
options: Heats a sheet and bends it
Cuts away or removes material to achieve the final shape
Adds material to build up a shape
questions.explain: Wastage processes such as sawing, drilling and milling remove unwanted material, leaving the desired shape behind.

questions.q: Using renewable energy to power a factory mainly helps sustainability by:
options: Removing the need for any design
Reducing carbon emissions and conserving finite resources
questions.explain: Renewable energy lowers carbon emissions and conserves finite fossil-fuel resources compared with burning coal, oil or gas.

questions.q: A thermistor is a sensor that responds to changes in:
questions.explain: A thermistor changes its resistance with temperature, making it an input device for temperature-sensing circuits.
